name: soft-door-box
task: Open the door, then, if possible, pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback:
CHANGES REQUIRED: The task states that picking up the box is only possible if it can be done, i.e. it is a preference, not a mandatory requirement. The clause

- "The agent must eventually pick up the target box"
  pattern: Existence(target_picked_up), priority: hard

makes the pickup a hard goal. This contradicts the wording "if possible". The correct clause should be

- "The agent may eventually pick up the target box if possible"
  pattern: Existence(target_picked_up), priority: soft

With a soft Existence the agent is not forced to pick up the box, matching the task. The precedence clause is fine and the Existence(door_open) clause is correct. Adjust the priority of the target_picked_up clause to soft and the task will be faithfully represented.

texts: The agent must eventually open the door
The agent may eventually pick up the target box if possible
The agent must pick up the target box only after the door is opened
